info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Etas-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare ETA Retrieval API provides timely estimated arrival times for rideshare services, enabling users to efficiently plan their journeys. It offers detailed information about ride statuses and expected time of arrivals for various routes. This API is particularly useful for application developers looking to integrate real-time ride information into their platforms, enhancing user experience and operational transparency. Typical consumers include rideshare service providers and third-party travel apps aiming to deliver accurate ETA data to their users.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated time of arrival for rides
get.description: This endpoint allows users to get the estimated time of arrival for a specific ride based on the provided parameters. It is designed to help users plan their journeys effectively by providing timely information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide necessary parameters for retrieving estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a ride. Ensure that all required fields are present and formatted correctly to receive accurate results.

200.description: Successfully retrieved estimated time of arrival.
